verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents its own REST API using OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, explicitly meant for server-to-server calls without an end user. It also supports scoped credentials, so card, statement and payment operations can run unattended from scripts or automation. There is no documented CLI, CI integration guidance or published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), so headless use is possible but only through raw API calls. Missing for 10: official CLI or SDK for headless runs, CI/CD-specific docs or examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Conta Simples API uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials for authentication. This flow is suited for server-to-server calls without an end user.
A credential can only access the routes of the scopes granted to it, and scopes cannot be edited afterwards. Grant only what the integration uses.
